items.implication: TB QB downgrade; Egbuka/others impacted by rookie starter.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup QB streamers; WR caution with new QB.

items.why: LP-DNP-LP practice; bigger dock for foot/ribs but expected.
items.implication: Cautious start in tough SEA matchup; monitor pregame.
items.opportunity: Primary target if active; volume if no further limits.

items.why: Limited but expected; no hard pitch count per reports.

items.text: LOVE/parlay Jordan Addison without Jefferson vs MIA: Dolphins allow 2nd-highest catch rate to WRs. Also Michael Wilson 7+ targets vs NYG.
items.why: JJ out creates opportunity; MIA soft vs WRs; Wilson consistent targets.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins return (hamstring); Cowboys DvP inflates opposing WR by 7.3% (most in NFL). Jordan Addison opportunity home vs borderline secondary with JJ out. Eagles without Smith/Goedert/Baun (now +Johnson Q).
items.why: DvP smash for Collins; Addison truthers moment with JJ out; Eagles depletion worse.
items.implication: Start Collins strongly; Addison smash spot; fade Eagles pass-catchers or note OL issues.
items.opportunity: Collins high targets; Addison WR1 volume; Eagles WR/TE committee or backups up.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (ankle). Jordan Addison gets full opportunity home vs MIA borderline secondary.
items.why: Ankle from prior; confirmed OUT list.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: AD Mitchell likely out again; 36% TS last without him; 78% catch rate, CHI allows 14+ ypr. Parlay leg too.
items.why: Clear alpha with Mitchell out; efficiency + matchup.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game; full workhorse with Dowdle out.
items.why: Lead back role solidified; great matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career TS/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% TS last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 util, 3.5% TS, 25% routes, snaps down to 42%; SEA 2.9 YPC allowed (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Low involvement + elite run D matchup.

items.text: HATE Justin Herbert @ SEA: 44% pressure rate; SEA 4th pressure, league-low 5.0 YPA/7.7 YPC; Chargers bottom-3 implied total.
HATE Emeka Egbuka (rookie QB Daniels start, low RZ, low total); Xavier Worthy (shrinking TS as Rice rises, low aDOT, LV tough); Kyle Pitts (16% TS/low prod with Penix).
